latest_release.body:
<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at 1.67.0 -->

## What's Changed
### New Features 🎉
* [feature] Update default light and dark named theme colors by @mayagbarnes in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/17450
* [feature] Add `required` parameter to `st.date_input` by @lukasmasuch in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/17165
* [feature] Allow a pixel width on st.dialog by @lukasmasuch in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/17412
* [feature] Update default theme surfaces and sidebar fallback by @mayagbarnes in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/17467
* [feature] Use theme primary for st.map default markers by @mayagbarnes in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/17493
* [feature] Add required parameter to st.time_input by @lukasmasuch in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/17420
* [feature] Add per-function max_size to st.cache_data by @sfc-gh-lwilby-1 in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/17552
* [feature] Add `required` parameter to `st.datetime_input` by @sfc-gh-lmasuch in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/17565
* [feature] Add `required` parameter to `st.text_area` by @sfc-gh-lmasuch in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/17590
* [feature] Add on_select selections to st.echarts_chart by @lukasmasuch in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16786
* [feature] Add server.maxCacheDataSize cache budget by @sfc-gh-lwilby-1 in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/17553
* [feature] Opaque default theme chrome and borders on by default by @mayagbarnes in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/17495
* [feature] Send Vega-Lite selections when gestures end by @sfc-gh-lwilby-1 in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/17666
* [feature] Expose the agent API to drive apps over HTTP by @lukasmasuch in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/17731
* [feature] Add a server default TTL for st.connection by @sfc-gh-gwatters in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/17248
* [feature] Add `required` parameter to `st.selectbox` by @lukasmasuch in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/17676
* [feature] Send st.echarts_chart dataframes as Arrow by @lukasmasuch in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/17678
* [feature] Show data table for st.echarts_chart by @lukasmasuch in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/17708
* [feature] Add `icon` parameter to `st.selectbox` by @lukasmasuch in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/17850
* [feature] Add help to st.Page for nav tooltips by @lukasmasuch in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/17807
* [feature] MCP endpoint for agent-accessible apps by @lukasmasuch in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/17510
* [feature] Add `st.grid` for responsive grid layouts by @lukasmasuch in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/17800
### Bug Fixes 🐛
* [fix] Add AppTest file uploads for chat input by @lukasmasuch in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/17464
* [fix] Make unknown container methods type errors by @lukasmasuch in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/17475
* [fix] Add AppTest support for st.data_editor by @lukasmasuch in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/17476
* [fix] Top nav section dropdown keyboard and ARIA by @mayagbarnes in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/17423
* [fix] Align st.components types with runtime by @lukasmasuch in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/17501
* [fix] Let the default time slider reach time.max by @lukasmasuch in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/17504
* [fix] Let page scroll pass over ECharts inside dataZoom by @lukasmasuch in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/17507
* [fix] Prevent resuming a session after logout by @lukasmasuch in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/17310
* [fix] Skip overflowed top-nav links in tab order by @mayagbarnes in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/17482
* [fix] Preserve queued trigger valu
